about_the_game:
Claritas RPG - Extra Hero Pack 2


Unlock four powerful new heroes and expand your strategic options in battle! Each hero brings unique abilities and playstyles to enhance your party in new and exciting ways.

Mermaid

Consumed by an intense desire of sleeping with the prince, she morphed into a humanoid form. After seducing him, she savagely killed and devoured him, only to be enslaved by the king as punishment.

Attributes:
Strength: 40 + 4 per Level
Intelligence: 40 + 4 per Level
Dexterity: 40 + 4 per Level

Skills:
Trident: Strikes one enemy with a trident, dealing 3 hits at once.
Rend: Attacks decrease the target's speed and damage them at the start of their turn.
Enthrall: Enthralls the target, decreasing their damage to you and healing you if they die.
Siren's Song: Enthralls all enemies and deals massive damage and stun on your next turn.

Star Lord

Stranded on this world, this Force‑wielding exile seeks their lost starship, channeling telekinetic power and calm resolve to conquer dangers and uncover hidden truths.

Attributes:
Strength: 30 + 3 per Level
Intelligence: 30 + 3 per Level
Dexterity: 60 + 6 per Level

Skills:
Light Saber: Strikes one enemy with a light saber, dealing lightning or fire damage.
Blasters: Shoots 3–5 random enemies with blasters, dealing lightning or fire damage.
The Force: Leverages the Force to increase your lowest attribute every turn.
Mind Trick: Confuses the target enemy using the Force, making them attack their allies.

Geomancer

This formidable mage wields unparalleled mastery over the earth, summoning volcanic eruptions to incinerate his enemies. Revered and feared, even mighty drakes bow before his awe‑inspiring power.

Attributes:
Strength: 30 + 3 per Level
Intelligence: 50 + 5 per Level
Dexterity: 40 + 4 per Level

Skills:
Seismic Charge: Draws energy from the earth to empower your skills.
Geyser: Erupts a geyser under the enemy, dealing fire damage.
Earthquake: Causes the ground to shake, dealing impact damage to all enemies.
Volcano: Erupts a volcano that will damage enemies every turn.

Alchemist

The master of drugs and toxins, she can leverage her versatile arsenal to aid her allies or destroy her enemies.

Attributes:
Strength: 30 + 3 per Level
Intelligence: 60 + 6 per Level
Dexterity: 30 + 3 per Level

Skills:
Acid Spray: Throws acid at the enemy, dealing toxic damage and decreasing resistance.
Swift Concoction: Passively decreases the AP cost of using items.
Steroid: Injects powerful steroids on an ally, granting speed and HP/MP regen.
Volatile Mixture: Blends powerful reagents for powerful, but unpredictable effects.

Add these heroes to your roster today and forge new legends in battle!
